name: carousel
title: Carousel
author: AlgorizeTech
description: Three image carousels in one file — a plain slider, a full-bleed hero with autoplay, and a thumbnail-navigated gallery. Reach for it for product shots, galleries and landing-page heroes.
docs: Named exports: ImageCarousel, HeroCarousel, CustomCarousel. All three take an images array; HeroCarousel adds autoplay and CustomCarousel adds thumbnail navigation. Built on next/image, so remote hosts must be allowed in next.config.
